description.p: HealthCoach is a modern, local-first personal health management and analytics application. Designed to maximize user empowerment, health insight, and day-to-day tracking efficiency, HealthCoach gives you total control over your health metrics, with compound multi-axis charts, and seamless cross-device synchronization.
